subsystems.name: Tokenizer and embedding
subsystems.role: turns text into discrete tokens and vectors the denoiser can work on.

subsystems.name: Denoising network
subsystems.role: a transformer with bidirectional attention that predicts clean tokens from a corrupted sequence.

subsystems.name: Noise process and objective
subsystems.role: defines how training sequences are corrupted and what the network is scored on.

subsystems.name: Inference sampler
subsystems.role: starts from noise or all-masked tokens and refines the whole sequence over several steps.

subsystems.name: Conditioning and control
subsystems.role: keeps generation on-prompt and supports infilling or constraint-following.

subsystems.name: Serving stack
subsystems.role: runs many refinement steps efficiently on accelerators.

buildSteps.title: Assemble training data
buildSteps.detail: Collect and clean a large text corpus, then train or reuse a subword tokenizer.

buildSteps.title: Choose the diffusion formulation
buildSteps.detail: Decide between discrete masked diffusion over tokens and continuous diffusion over embeddings; each changes the network, loss and sampler.

buildSteps.title: Train the denoiser
buildSteps.detail: Corrupt sequences with the chosen noise process, feed them to a bidirectional transformer, and train it to recover the original tokens.

buildSteps.title: Tune the noise schedule
buildSteps.detail: Adjust how much of a sequence is masked or noised at each training step and how losses are weighted, so easy and hard cases both teach the model.

buildSteps.title: Build the sampler
buildSteps.detail: At inference, start from noise or all-masked positions and iteratively unmask or denoise; use confidence scores to decide which positions to fix first.

buildSteps.title: Add guidance and editing
buildSteps.detail: Condition on prompts, apply guidance to strengthen instruction-following, and mask regions to support infilling and local edits.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate quality and speed
buildSteps.detail: Measure output quality, latency, controllability and long-sequence behaviour against autoregressive baselines.

buildSteps.title: Optimize serving
buildSteps.detail: Reduce refinement steps through distillation, cache computation where possible, and batch requests to keep latency low.

prerequisites.why: the denoiser is usually a transformer, but with bidirectional rather than causal attention.

prerequisites.tech: Large text corpora and pretraining pipelines
prerequisites.why: the model still needs broad language knowledge before diffusion training can shape it.
training and multi-step sampling both need substantial parallel compute.
masked diffusion works in research, but few-step high-quality sampling is still being improved.
standard benchmarks assume left-to-right generation, so editing and parallel decoding need new tests.

pathway.milestone: research models and early APIs showing competitive quality on some tasks
pathway.unlocks: proof that parallel refinement can generate coherent text.

pathway.milestone: distilled samplers cutting refinement to a small number of steps
pathway.unlocks: latency advantages over autoregressive models in interactive use.
tools that revise documents or code in place rather than rewriting from the start.

pathway.milestone: scaling to frontier quality with predictable training laws
pathway.unlocks: a genuine alternative generation paradigm for products and agents.
